message.content:
I don’t have access to live traffic feeds, so I can’t give you the real‑time traffic conditions for New York right now.  

If you’re looking for up‑to‑date traffic information, you can check:

| Service | How to use |
|---------|------------|
| **Google Maps** | Open the app or website, type “New York” or a specific address/route, and tap the “Traffic” layer. |
| **Waze** | Open the app, search for your destination, and the map will show current traffic speeds and incidents. |
| **City of New York DOT** | Their website (nyc.gov/dot) offers traffic cameras and incident reports. |
| **NYC Open Data** | The NYC Open Data portal has datasets on traffic volume and congestion that you can explore. |

If you let me know a specific intersection, street, or route you’re interested in, I can describe typical traffic patterns for that area (e.g., peak hours, known bottlenecks).
